subject: Post-call: FinHealth security follow-up - SOC 2, pen test report & vuln process
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finhealth.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-14T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call: FinHealth security follow-up - SOC 2, pen test report & vuln process

Hi Alex — great talking earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery focused on security/compliance: 

- You asked for our SOC 2 attestation and any recent pen test reports (redacted is fine).
- You wanted an overview of our vulnerability management cadence and SLA commitments.
- You asked for a vendor security questionnaire (FinHealth will either send one or wants a link to ours).

Attached are the items I can share immediately: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf and a redacted pen test summary (Redwood_PenTest_Report_Redacted_202602.pdf). For full pen test reports we'd typically share under an NDA; happy to start that process if you need the detailed remediation timeline.

Key points about our vulnerability management process (summary):
- External pentests: annual third-party engagement; we publish a customer‑facing redacted summary and share full reports under NDA.
- Scanning cadence: automated internal SAST/DAST + dependency scanning weekly; external attack surface scans monthly.
- Triage/SLA by severity: Critical - 7 days; High - 30 days; Medium - 90 days; Low - next regular release. Emergency patches are supported and we have a documented rollback plan.
- Disclosure policy: coordinated vulnerability disclosure; we work with reporters on fixes and CVE assignment where applicable.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm if FinHealth needs the full pen test report (if so, we can route an NDA and provide the redacted report in the meantime).
2) If you have a vendor questionnaire, send it over; otherwise I can share a link to our questionnaire and a short SOC 2 summary doc.
3) If helpful, loop in our security lead (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) for a 30‑minute technical Q&A.

Happy to coordinate times.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf, Redwood_PenTest_Report_Redacted_202602.pdf

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finhealth.com
Date: 2027-03-14T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinHealth security follow-up - SOC 2, pen test report & vuln process

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap and appreciate the quick turnaround.

A few notes from our security team (cc'd):
- We'd like the redacted pen test for now. We will likely request the full report under NDA if the redacted doc is insufficient for our internal reviewers.
- We're preparing a vendor security questionnaire and will send it today; alternatively, if you have a hosted questionnaire link that prepopulates answers, please send.
- Important for us: confirmation that you support encrypted customer data-at-rest for customer-managed keys (we will follow up separately with specific KMS questions).

Can we set a 30-minute call later this week with your security lead? Wed/Thu mornings PT work for us.

Best,
Alex Jenkins
Director, Platform Security
FinHealth
alex.jenkins@finhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finhealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-14T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinHealth security follow-up - SOC 2, pen test report & vuln process

Thanks Alex — looping in Rishi (our Head of Security) to coordinate the technical Q&A.

Rishi — quick context: FinHealth (Alex) is evaluating Redwood for inference workloads that will process PD/PHI. They requested: SOC 2 Type II, pen test summary (redacted ok for now), and details on vuln mgmt SLAs and scanning cadence. Also asked about customer-managed keys for data‑at‑rest.

I've attached the SOC 2 Type II PDF and the redacted pen test summary. Also attached a text file with the questionnaire link we host for rapid triage (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Link.txt).

If you can confirm availability for a 30‑minute call on Thu 03/18 or Fri 03/19 AM PT, we can lock something with Alex. On the call we should be ready to:
- Walk through our pen test scope and redaction practice.
- Confirm KMS options (we support BYOK via partner KMS integrations and an on‑prem key option for Private deployments).
- Describe remediation SLAs by severity and provide an example timeline for a High/Critical finding.

Thanks — I can provide proposed times once you confirm.

-Marissa

From: rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-15T01:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinHealth security follow-up - SOC 2, pen test report & vuln process

Hi Alex — thanks for including security. I'm available Thu 03/18 at 9:30 AM PT for a technical Q&A. I've added a brief agenda below and a link to our questionnaire for faster intake: https://drive.google.com/redwood/security/finhealth-questionnaire (attachment: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Link.txt).

Proposed 30-min agenda:
1) Quick intros and scope of your expected workload (5 min)
2) Pen test/reporting: what we share publicly vs under NDA; redaction policy (5 min)
3) Vulnerability management & SLAs: severity definitions, triage timelines, examples (10 min)
4) KMS/BYOK brief and next steps (5 min)

Vulnerability management details (summary):
- Detection: weekly SCA (software composition analysis), weekly internal SAST pipelines, external attack surface scans monthly, third‑party pentest annually.
- Triage: Findings are classified per CVSS-aligned severity + business impact.
- SLAs: Critical - remediation/mitigation plan within 72 hours and patch within 7 days where feasible; High - fix or mitigation within 30 days; Medium - prioritized within 90 days; Low - scheduled for next release cycle. (We escalate Critical issues to operations and execs immediately.)
- Disclosure: We follow coordinated disclosure; public writeups are redacted and shared only after customer-sensitive data is removed. For full reports we require an NDA; we can start an NDA today if helpful.

If you want the full pen test report under NDA, we can share a standard mutual NDA and then transmit the report via secure transfer (and redact customer‑specific findings).

Looking forward to the call — propose Thu 3/18 9:30 AM PT.

-Rishi
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: FinHealth security follow-up - SOC 2, pen test report & vuln process

Thanks everyone — Thu 3/18 9:30 AM PT is confirmed on our side.

Quick answers/asks before the call: 
- Please send the NDA template and we will run it through procurement; once in place we may request the full pen test report.
- We'll fill out the questionnaire (link looks good). Expect it back by EOD Monday.
- For remediation SLAs — can you provide a short one‑page doc that maps severity -> target response/patch windows that we can attach to our risk review? That will help accelerate approval.

If you can send the NDA and the one‑page SLA mapping before EOD tomorrow, that's perfect.

Alex
Director, Platform Security
FinHealth
alex.jenkins@finhealth.com
